title: Uthman's Well
paragraphs: During a severe water shortage in Madinah, one particular well was privately owned, forcing the community to pay a high price for water they desperately needed for their families and livestock.
Uthman ibn Affan, already known for his wealth and generosity, purchased the well and made a decision that surprised the entire community that had been struggling with the shortage.
Rather than keeping the well for himself or continuing to charge for its water, he dedicated it entirely to the public, allowing everyone free access regardless of their financial situation.
This single act of generosity is still referenced today in discussions about charitable giving, showing that solving a community problem sometimes requires one person's decisive, selfless action.
